subject: general
question: A. B, E, F, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A sits second to the right of B. Only one person sits between B and E. R sits to the immediate right of F. P is not an immediate neighbour of E. Who sits third to the left of Q?
solution:
Given:

A. B, E, F, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) A sits second to the right of B.

2) Only one person sits between B and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/645069ae5ed8ebccb2aac7e508c445011ab762d3c864361c5aa731b3d38e6e01.png] 

3) R sits to the immediate right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/678056fff0aafe52a35af5397ef48cfbe2984da55a8db364466c872200c018ff.png] 

4) P is not an immediate neighbour of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f54728d9540c46266c3848b78a8c0d8f1ddb43dc6a0f5e05f9aeec8a022b6da2.png] 

So, **'F' **sits third to the left of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (1)".**
